facts.value: The Career Service of Goethe University offers workshops each semester where you can work intensively with your interests and goals, your individual strengths, and your professional profile under the guidance of experienced trainers.

The Career Service supports you with practical and workshop offerings to help you integrate your individual skills into the application process and successfully take the first steps into the job market.
In addition, you can establish practical contacts and acquire important professional key skills through the offered formats.
The 'Bachelor meets Business' event series offered every winter semester provides students with the opportunity to make contacts with well-known companies within the university.
The annual career planner of Goethe University provides insights on what to consider during the early steps of your professional career.
The Career Service and its partners offer various workshops on application training each semester, teaching you what to focus on when applying in the German and international job market.
You can have your application documents checked through the application check offered by the Career Service.
You can enhance your soft skills by utilizing various offerings to expand your presentation skills and methodological knowledge through workshops and events.
